timer.counter: 16-bit wrapping up-counter clocked once per E-cycle and reset to 0000; an FRC_MSB write presets FFF8 while saving the bus byte, and a following FRC_LSB write replaces the full counter with the saved high byte and current low byte
timer.coherent_read: reading high latches low; low reads return that latch
timer.output_compare: match sets OCF and transfers OLVL to P21; comparison is inhibited for the upper-byte write cycle and the following cycle
timer.input_capture: selected P20 edge transfers the synchronized counter and sets ICF; P20 must be configured as input
timer.overflow: TOF is set when the counter increments from FFFF to 0000

flag_clear.ICF: read TCSR while set, then read ICR_MSB
flag_clear.OCF: read TCSR while set, then write either OCR byte
flag_clear.TOF: read TCSR while set, then read FRC_MSB

timer.interrupt: enabled ICF, OCF, and TOF generate IRQ2 and select distinct priority vectors

sci.compatibility: The asynchronous transmitter, receiver, clocks, controls, flags, and interrupt functions follow the documented HD6801-compatible SCI except for the explicitly listed framing-error transfer rule.
sci.framing_error: A missing stop bit sets ORFE without RDRF and does not transfer the receive shift-register byte into RDR.
sci.implemented_clock_modes: internally clocked NRZ modes with divisors 16, 128, 1024, and 4096

operating_modes.mode7: single-chip operation with all program memory and vectors in the internal F000-FFFF mask-ROM window; implemented
operating_modes.other_modes: Modes 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6 are documented but outside the current HD6301V1 wrapper
operating_modes.sleep: SLP stops CPU execution while peripherals continue; an enabled interrupt vectors and a masked request resumes at the following instruction
operating_modes.standby: STBY stops all clocks and enters reset while RAM retention depends on documented supply conditions; not yet implemented

memory_control.RAME: bit 6 resets set and enables the 0080-00FF internal RAM; clearing it disables that physical RAM, leaving the Mode-7 addresses without an externally accessible memory device
memory_control.STBY_PWR: read/write retained-supply validity bit; FPGA profile deterministically clears it on reset and when standby_power_ok_i is false
memory_control.address_trap: instruction fetches from 0000-007F or 0100-EFFF invoke unmaskable TRAP; normal data accesses do not

implementation_scope.rtl: rtl/hd6301/hd6301v1_mcu.sv implements the single-chip Mode-7 digital boundary and accepts a separate 4-KiB FPGA program image
implementation_scope.model: model/hd6301v1_device.py independently classifies Mode-7 E-cycle transactions, GPIO/handshake state, program memory, and address errors
implementation_scope.verification: Directed RTL execution covers internal reset/vector fetch, executable RAM, both address-error ranges through representative fetch, Port 3/4 GPIO, IS3 latch and ordered flag clear, both OS3 selections, masked SLP wake, and enabled IS3 interrupt vectoring
implementation_scope.excluded_modes: Expanded modes, physical multiplexed/non-multiplexed bus pins, standby entry, bi-phase SCI, and external-clock SCI remain unclaimed
